regime_context: The detector shows a broad rotational environment with 78% of themes eligible for the absolute trend gate. Memory/HBM leads the momentum ranking but shows fading momentum, zero breadth, and mixed durability. The absolute trend gate has historically improved drawdown control for US equities (gate_helps=true), but the thematic call track record is poor (hit rate 40%, direction accuracy 25%). All leans are low-conviction, anchored to the validated risk-control gate, not return forecasts.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is eligible on the absolute trend gate and shows strong durability (0.75), full breadth (1.0), and a trending regime. It is not crowded, so no reflexivity-caution cap. The only validated edge is the gate, and this theme satisfies it cleanly.
theses.dissent: Silver miners are inherently volatile and can reverse sharply on macro shifts; the trend may be mature and vulnerable to profit‑taking.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 5% within the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is eligible and has the highest durability_bar in the universe (0.9), full breadth, and a clear trend regime. The crowded flag is a sizing-down caution, not a fade; the absolute trend gate supports an overweight directional lean as long as the trend persists.
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (z=2.02) means any negative catalyst can trigger a violent unwind; the trend may be over-owned and fragile.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 5% within the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Non-AI Software fails the absolute trend gate (eligible=false) – the only validated risk‑control edge. Despite high durability (0.8) and full breadth, the gate signals that the theme is not in a reliable uptrend, and avoidance historically reduces drawdown exposure.
theses.dissent: The theme has strong breadth and high durability; it could mean‑revert sharply and outperform once the gate flips, making the avoid call a whipsaw.

falsifier.text: The Non-AI Software theme becomes eligible (absolute trend gate flips to true) before 2026-08-17

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
